about.description: sBNC is a tokenized wrapper for CEA Industries Inc. (Nasdaq: BNC), the public BNB Digital Asset Treasury company that rebranded/re-tickered from its legacy cultivation business after pivoting to accumulate BNB as a primary treasury asset (holding hundreds of thousands of BNB). StableStock custody flow is: 1:1 shares held through StableBroker's licensed broker rails (StableStock x HabitTrade partnership), issued as a BEP-20 on BNB Chain, with on-chain liquidity provided jointly by StableStock and Native. sBNC is particularly notable as a BNB-native on-chain way to gain leveraged-equity exposure to the BNB reserve thesis. KYC is required at mint/redeem.
about.registryInfo: StableStock sTokens are issued under StableBroker, StableStock's licensed-broker infrastructure operated with HabitTrade. HabitTrade Pty Ltd holds AFSL 514654 (ABN 59 626 521 202, Australia); HabitTrade LLC holds a US FinCEN MSB registration (31000229716152); HabitTrade (HK) Limited holds an SFC Type 1 licence (Hong Kong). StableStock custody relies on its US broker partner DriveWealth LLC, a FINRA/SIPC member US broker-dealer. StableStock's published backers/partners include YZi Labs, MPCi, Vertex Ventures, Foresight Ventures, Amber Group and Dragonfly.
